messages.subject: First fall meeting today, 1:10-3PM, Wickson 2124
parts:
Hi all,

A reminder that we'll have our first D-RUG work session for the fall today 1:10-3PM in Wickson 2124.

On today's agenda we'll have:

1. Introductions and discussion of topics for the quarter, and other organizational stuff
2. An tutorial on new debugging tools in RStudio
3. Regular co-work session and Q&A time.

If you only want #3, come at 4PM.  

There will be cookies. See you soon!

 - Noam

Noam Ross
Graduate Group in Ecology
Department of Environmental Science and Policy
University of California at Davis
+1.646.244.0484
http://www.noamross.net/
twitter: @noamross
